interface_detail: 'SFTP/FTP/HTTPS access' on every 10Gbps seedbox, with ruTorrent, Deluge, qBittorrent, Transmission, SABnzbd and NZBGet pre-installed.
tooling: SFTP or FTP client, a browser over HTTPS, and the one-click installer for 15+ apps; no API or CLI is documented on the page read
chaining: A USD 6.29 500 GB seedbox with an SFTP pull path; the fair-use rule on 'unlimited' bandwidth is the unverified part

limits.value: up to 10 Gbps, shared between tenants; unlimited bandwidth under a fair-use rule

limits_note: Sold by disk: 500 GB, 1 TB, 2 TB, 5 TB, 10 TB, and a custom quote from 20 TB. No byte quota or object cap is published.
binding_note: No quota, object cap or request rate is published; the shared 10 Gbps port and the unstated fair-use rule are the unmeasured risks.

identity_cost.detail: Account plus payment; the login is emailed once payment clears. Payment methods, phone and document requirements were not read: unverified.

reliability_note: Bandwidth is 'unlimited' under a fair-use rule whose limit is not published; the 10 Gbps port is shared.
confidence_note: Plan, price, protocols and guarantee are on the vendor page read on 2026-11-03. A measured rung needs a slot and a timed transfer.
